name: humanize-ai
description: Humanize your VS Code and Copilot Chat experience. Control with a gamepad — modular architecture for extensible gamepad integration.

commands.title: Show Gamepad Debug Info
commands.description: Outputs current gamepad state and active mappings to the output channel.

commands.title: Show Gamepad Debug Window
commands.description: Opens an SDL window visualizing gamepad state in real-time.

commands.title: Show Humanize AI - Avatar
commands.description: Shows the Humanize AI avatar panel with animated single-frame portrait.

humanizeAI.enabled.description: Enable gamepad input for Humanize AI

humanizeAI.pollingIntervalMs.description: Gamepad polling interval in milliseconds (lower = more responsive, higher CPU usage)

humanizeAI.debounceMs.description: Minimum time between repeated actions in milliseconds (prevents rapid duplicates)

humanizeAI.tts.backend.description: TTS backend: 'stub' (simulated), 'pocket' (Python server), or 'auto' (pick best available)

humanizeAI.tts.pocket.port.description: Port for the Pocket TTS Python server

humanizeAI.tts.pocket.modelPath.description: Optional path to a custom Pocket TTS model

humanizeAI.tts.pocket.voice.description: Voice identifier for Pocket TTS (HuggingFace URL, local file, or 'default'). Auto-downloaded on first use.

humanizeAI.http.port.description: Port for the local HTTP server (avatar state, emotion, message, TTS endpoints)
